room_rent.note: Room up to Category as per opted Sum Insured per Schedule; varies by SI tier — VERIFY exact category

icu.note: ICU charges covered under inpatient — VERIFY no separate cap

copayment.note: Active Plan has a compulsory co-payment on all claims (% unreadable in source due to font corruption — VERIFY, ManipalCigna lists 20%); removable via optional; not applied on sub-limited named ailments; zone-based co-pay also applies for higher-zone treatment

sub_limits.note: Sub-limits for Hernia, Hysterectomy, BPH, renal stones, Cataract (per eye), Total Knee Replacement (per knee), fracture treatment — vary by SI tier

initial_waiting.note: Excl03; not applicable after 12 months continuous coverage

maternity.note: No inbuilt maternity benefit found — VERIFY

cumulative_bonus.note: CB increases base SI yearly up to 100% max; per-year % unreadable in source (font corruption) — VERIFY (ManipalCigna Prime lists ~25%/yr)

restoration.note: 100% restoration available for any number of times during a Policy Year (D.I.8 e); not for same illness already claimed

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalization covered up to Schedule limit; day count unreadable in source — VERIFY (typically 60 days)

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalization covered up to Schedule limit; day count unreadable in source — VERIFY (typically 180 days)

day_care.note: Day care treatment covered per Annexure II list

organ_donor.note: Donor in-patient expenses up to SI

ambulance.note: Road ambulance up to limit specified in Schedule — VERIFY ₹ cap

modern_treatments.note: Robotic surgeries, Deep Brain stimulation, Oral chemotherapy, Immunotherapy, Stereotactic radiosurgery, Bronchial Thermoplasty, Stem cell, etc.
